contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return the largest element. Use fallback only for an empty array; fallback is not a lower bound on nonempty results.
contract.domain: The array is dense, has at most 32 finite numbers between -100 and 100, and must not be modified. Any returned array must be fresh with independent storage. Fallback is finite between -100 and 100.

inputRoles.fallback: result used only when array is empty

contract.outputRole: maximum element or fallback for empty array
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
